A1.label: SIMT / vector–tensor processors
A1.description: Instruction streams dispatch operations to programmable lanes, often alongside tensor engines.

B1.label: Structured tensor arrays
B1.description: Matrix engines dominate computation with structured flow and compiler-managed tiling.

B2.label: Flexible tensor datapaths
B2.description: Dedicated tensor engines, configurable DMA/local storage and mixed matrix/vector workloads.

C1.label: Reconfigurable spatial fabrics / CGRA
C1.description: Spatial mappings onto configurable compute/memory units and programmable interconnect.

C2.label: Distributed-memory spatial manycores
C2.description: Locally programmed cores, local SRAM and explicit network communication.

C3.label: Deterministic streaming processors
C3.description: Compute, memory access and communication are statically scheduled.

D1.label: Model-compiled datapaths
D1.description: Architecture or weights physically specialized for one model or model family.
